text:
incident-bot: SEV2 auto-alert — high restart rate in kv-paged allocator pool 'kv-usw2-1'. 18 pod restarts in 10m, pattern: CUDA OOMs then container exits. paging/fragmentation suspected. tagging @oncall and @infra :rotating_light:

sandeep: seeing the same. OOM backtrace shows paged-attn allocator failing when KV hit count spikes.

marta: customer impact: ~4% of requests getting 500s, mostly long-context chat routes. I've opened a quick dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv-porosity

ops_tony: rolling mitigation plan — 1) throttle heavy-request routes, 2) apply pod-level node-affinity to avoid flapping nodes, 3) force local cache eviction policy to aggressive for affected pool.

cheng: +1. Can we temporarily disable attention paging for the top offender model (rwd-llama-13b-v2) as a fallback? That should reduce fragmentation pressure.

paul: I pushed a canary to disable paging on one replica:
```
kubectl set env deployment/rwd-llama-13b-v2-canary ENABLE_PAGED_ATTENTION=false
```
observing memory usage now — looks flatter after 30s.

marta: started rate-limit rule on /v1/chat/longcontext to 5 r/s for free tier to limit noisy clients. customer success notified.

sandeep: logs from an affected pod (snippet):
```
[2026-03-17T21:01:02Z] cudaMemcpyAsync failed: out of memory (2)
[2026-03-17T21:01:02Z] paged_alloc.cpp:423 eviction failed, fragmentation > 0.87
[2026-03-17T21:01:03Z] aborting worker pid=2421, exit code=137
```

ops_tony: nodal action: cordon node ip-10-0-4-21, drain after existing requests complete. Marked as watch.

devex: can we get a quick eval to confirm output quality after disabling paging? I'll run a 50-sample smoke test and post results.

paul: quick note — increased kvcache eviction aggressiveness via feature flag on the cluster: `KV_EVICT_RATIO=0.65` (was 0.8). Hoping to reduce resident set growth.

marta: customer impact update: two enterprise customers saw elevated tail latencies, but no data loss. CS opened support tickets, flagged for proactive outreach.

sandeep: short-term checklist (do not remove until stabilised):
- keep one canary with paging disabled
- cordon + drain flapping nodes
- apply aggressive eviction flag globally for 2 hours
- keep rate-limit on longcontext routes
- monitor OOM/restart rate every 5m

cheng: logging TODO: add KV eviction / fragment_ratio to crash reports to make triage faster. Filing infra ticket RN.

incident-bot: Incident timeline note attached. Creating handoff when @sandeep goes OOO in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

paul: handing to @marta for next 2h watch. I'll leave the canary running and keep the eviction flag until wg infra OKs a rollback.

marta: ack — taking watch. Posting a short postmortem draft after stabilization. :thumbsup:
